author: Inside Edition
description: A 16-year-old girl was shot and killed during a dispute over loud music that turned into a physical fight in Albuquerque, New Mexico last month, according to police. Video of the incident is sending shockwaves across the country, in part because of the age of who police say pulled the trigger. He is a 10-year-old boy. Now, his mom, identified as Elaina Gomez-Villeda, is facing serious charges, including murder. She told police she was attacked by the 16 year-old and her mother after Gomez-Villeda says she complained about loud music.  During the incident, Gomez-Villeda told her son to "Get my gun."
title: Police: 10-Year-Old Boy Shot And Killed 16-Year-Old Girl In connection with Loud Music Dispute

author: Inside Edition
description: Tributes continue to pour in for Fiona the hippo, a beloved visitor favorite at the Cincinnati Zoo who died on Thursday. The hippopotamus survived a premature birth, and was named after Princess Fiona from "Shrek." But questions are being raised about her passing. How could America's favorite zoo animal die after swallowing a child's hat? Inside Edition's Alison Hall has more on what happened to Fiona.
title: How Could Fiona The Hippo Die After Eating A Child's Hat?

author: Inside Edition
description: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas, with decorations going up across the country. But one neighborhood in Utah may win the crown 'most festive,' thanks to the giant inflatable Santas in front of every single house. As Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports, Santas have definitely been super-sized this season.
title: Giant Inflatable Santas Invade Super-Festive Neighborhood

author: Inside Edition
description: A toddler lost for seven hours in a remote desert was found alive, wearing only a diaper, by a volunteer searcher. The toddler wandered away from her home in Arizona. The search for the missing 2-year-old was conducted in pitch blackness and temperatures had dropped to 45 degrees. Inside Edition’s Jim Moret spoke to the little girl’s mother Deanna Fritz. Little Vella was found crouching in a bush two miles from home by local volunteer Jay Stewart.
title: 2-Year-Old Girl Found Alive After Going Missing In Arizona Desert

author: Inside Edition
description: A man is accused of calling and texting 911 more than 1,400 times over three days. Authorities say the man called around the clock. When authorities arrived at his house outside Seattle, they asked the man what he needed from the police. The man said “nothing.” While police were in the apartment, they had 911 call the man to confirm he was the person dialing them. After police left, cops say the calls resumed.
title: Man Makes Over 1,000 911 Calls In 3 Days

author: Inside Edition
description: Instead of doing back-breaking yard work, some people are hiring Manscapers to do it for them. The men ditch their shirts and dig into dirt. The manscapers, whose work involves planting and landscaping, are getting lots of attention online. Manscapers co-owner Garrett Magee tells Inside Edition their work speaks for itself. Magee and co-owner James DeSantis say their shirtless hunks are getting hired by housewives left and right.
title: Some Are Turning To ‘Manscapers’' Shirtless Men To Do Their Yard Work

author: Inside Edition
description: A video camera on a New York City bus captured the moment a Brooklyn building collapsed and killed eight people. The camera showed the bus pulling away from a green light and seconds later, the apartment structure crumbles to the ground in a cloud of dust and rubble. A massive rescue search followed, with several people, including a pregnant woman, pried from wreckage. The city says 18 injured people were pulled from the debris.
title: Bus Video Shows How Quickly Building Collapsed In Brooklyn Killing 8

author: Inside Edition
description: A five-week-old puppy was found in a Massachusetts dumpster after a good Samaritan told police they heard the cries from the animal. Police say a clue inside the trash bag helped them track down the suspect, a child’s piece of homework with their name on it, which led authorities to find the parents. When police searched the apartment they found five more puppies and their mother.
title: Cops Find 5-Week-Old Puppy In Garbage Bag Inside Dumpster

author: Inside Edition
description: It’s the end of an era that many animal rights advocates say is long overdue. New York City is banning the horse-and-carriage industry. Romanch’s Law was named for an 18-year-old tourist who died in June after jumping from a horse carriage to help his mother, who had been thrown from her seat when the horse bolted. Advocates for animals have long tried to get horses off city streets, citing safety and health concerns, but the industry says it won’t go down without a fight. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: NYC Ban On Horse And Carriage Rides To Take Effect In 2028

author: Inside Edition
description: The footage could have been a scene from “Grand Theft Auto” or a “Fast and Furious” movie trailer. Authorities say brazen real-life train robberies were caught on camera, and the alleged thieves have now been arrested. The Department of Justice announced Thursday that 14 suspects had been taken into custody and charged in a 17-count federal indictment. The alleged crew targeted at least three dozen trains and stole more than $22 million worth of goods, including Nike sneakers and Milwaukee brand tools, then resold them on the black market, according to federal prosecutors.
title: Brazen Train Thefts Caught On Camera Lead To 14 Arrests

author: Inside Edition
description: Ever wanted to drive like James Bond? For the right price, you can. Growing fears of violent crime and terrorism are fueling a surge in armored car sales among wealthy Americans. Inside Edition got a close-up look at some of the top vehicles on the market, loaded with defensive gadgets like infrared cameras, smoke screens, and electrified door handles.
title: James Bond Is Back And Now You Can Drive Just Like Him In Bulletproof Cars
